svg.text: HR-V0-JOINT-MET-P0.1 / NO PURCHASE, MOTION OR ENERGIZATION RELEASE
Exact two XM540, two H101, two S102
Serials, lots, kit inventory and photographs
HSI-001..006 and HSI-013..014 can close only after received physical execution and qualified acceptance.
HSI-007..012 gain geometry screens; final cable, guard, load-path and attachment-use evidence remains external.
HSI-015..020 cannot close from a bare joint stack: harness, guard, structural, dynamic, bumper and supplier evidence is still required.
No encoder value is read unpowered. No screw enters an actuator until the exact temporary assembly instruction is signed.
Hand-positioned poses are measurements only. Never force an angle or use the actuator, cable, connector, case or fixture as a design stop.
After measurement: teardown, inspect, re-inventory, re-quarantine, hash the raw evidence, and obtain qualified disposition.
Current state: 0 of 20 HSI rows closed; 8 hold points open; no physical execution claimed.
Do not order, assemble for use, connect, power, move or energize from this diagram.
